_comment: Publication contract for everxyz OCCT build artifacts, modelled on Utopia's
Kept identical to Utopia where the property is part of the shared contract:
region, endpoints, object_key_prefix, transport_encoding and bucket_contract.
A consumer that can restore a Utopia engineering asset can restore an OCCT
artifact with the same code path.
Deliberately NOT shared with Utopia: the bucket and the RAM roles. OCCT
binaries are a different asset class from Utopia's fixtures and vendor SDKs,
so they get their own bucket and their own publish/read roles. Reusing
everxyz-utopia-fixtures-cn-shenzhen would let an OCCT build job write into
Every value here is overridable at runtime by the matching OCCT_OSS_*
repository variable, so the bucket can be renamed without a code change.

publication_contract.digest_covers: the plaintext artifact, before transport encoding

_comment: GitHub OIDC federated into RAM via sts:AssumeRoleWithOIDC. This is the
closest available analogue to Utopia's ACK RRSA path: the workload proves
its identity with a short-lived OIDC token and receives short-lived STS
credentials. No static AccessKey is stored in this repository.
Utopia's other mechanism, aliyun-cli OAuth, is for humans at a terminal and
cannot work unattended on a runner.
